name: @sparx/platform-crm-worker
description: sparx platform-CRM worker. Receives tenant + module lifecycle events via Pub/Sub push (Cloud Run HTTP entrypoint) and mirrors them into the PLATFORM tenant's own CRM (docs/140): a signup becomes a contact + a deal on the 'Tenant Signups' pipeline, and later events move that deal through trial → activated → paying / churned. Idempotent on redelivery.
